desc:
🏍️ GDR Tuning - Screws. Modifications. Driving.

Welcome to the small town of the 80s! Get your own garage with a lift, buy old mopeds, and rebuild them piece by piece.

🔧 Screws - Cylinders, Carburetor, Exhaust, Transmission: real installation and removal using tools
⚡ Tuning - more horsepower, revs, big bore kits, custom paint job
⛽ Driving - Mix and shake gasoline 1:50, kickstart, release the clutch
🤸 Wheelies - balance on the back wheel and break the record of all servers
🏁 Races - Best times, MX Park, and live races against friends
💰 Trading - Ads in the newspaper, haggling with buyers, rare parts from the western trader
📸 Speed traps, police checks, courier jobs, customer orders, clubs, and more

6 locations, country roads, fields, mountains, and avenues await you!

🎮 PC (Mobile & Console coming soon)
👍 Like & Favorite if you like it - updates are coming constantly!
